# coolify_server_image_scanning (Resource)

Manages image vulnerability scanning for one Coolify server (`GET`/`PATCH /servers/{uuid}/image-scanning`). Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. Turning scanning on prepares the scanner on the server in the background. Destroy turns scanning off. The scanner state fields are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_server_image_scanning" "example" {
  server_uuid           = coolify_server.example.uuid
  is_image_scan_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_uuid` (String) UUID of the server.

### Optional

- `is_image_scan_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this server scans images of its resources. The server setting default is false. Leaving it unset keeps the value Coolify already stored.

### Read-Only

- `scanner_built_at` (String) Time of the vulnerability database on the server, as an RFC3339 timestamp.
- `scanner_disk_used_bytes` (Number) Disk space the scanner uses on the server, in bytes.
- `scanner_failed_step` (String) Step that failed when `scanner_state` is `failed`.
- `scanner_state` (String) Scanner state on the server: `pulling`, `updating_database`, `ready`, or `failed`. Null when Coolify has not reported one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_server_image_scanning.example <server-uuid>
```
